<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- gen-docs` from `mt_config::menu::MENUS`. Do not edit. -->

How to configure menus: [Context menus](/docs/context-menus/).

## `viewport`

Right-click in a pane's terminal grid. Acts on the pane under the pointer.

- **Facts** (`when`): `title`, `cwd`, `cmd`, `domain`, `status`, `exited`, `focused`, `link`, `selection`, `word`, `line`, `on_prompt`, `in_output`, `alt_screen`, `mouse_reporting`, `panes`, `tabs`, `zoomed`, `remote`, `local`, `last_exit`, `idle`, `running`
- **Placeholders**: `{selection}`, `{word}`, `{line}`, `{link}`, `{path}`, `{path:line}`, `{cwd}`, `{pane}`, `{tab}`, `{window}`, `{title}`, `{domain}`, `{host}`, `{last_command}`, `{last_output}`, `{exit_code}`
- **Allowed kinds**: `action`, `send`, `spawn`, `ctl`, `submenu`, `separator`, `header`, `include`
- **Shell-registrable**: yes (M11.2)

**Built-in items**

- `copy`: Copy, enabled when `selection`, chip of `Copy`
- `paste`: Paste, chip of `Paste`
- `select_all`: Select all, chip of `SelectAll`
- `open_link`: Open link, enabled when `link`
- `copy_link`: Copy link, enabled when `link`
- `search`: Search for selection, enabled when `selection`
- `save_as_snippet`: Save selection as snippet…, shown when `selection`, chip of `SaveSelectionAsSnippet`
- `clear_scrollback`: Clear scrollback, chip of `ClearScrollback`
- `panes`: Panes (group)
  - `zoom`: Toggle zoom, chip of `TogglePaneZoom`
  - `swap`: Swap, shown when `panes>1`
    - `swap_left`: Swap left, chip of `SwapPane(left)`
    - `swap_right`: Swap right, chip of `SwapPane(right)`
    - `swap_up`: Swap up, chip of `SwapPane(up)`
    - `swap_down`: Swap down, chip of `SwapPane(down)`
  - `rotate`: Rotate, shown when `panes>1`, chip of `RotatePanes`
  - `split_left`: Split left, chip of `Split(left)`
  - `split_right`: Split right, chip of `SplitHorizontal`
  - `split_up`: Split up, chip of `Split(up)`
  - `split_down`: Split down, chip of `SplitVertical`
  - `close_pane`: Close pane, chip of `ClosePane`

## `tab`

Right-click on a tab header. Pane facts are those of the tab's active pane.

- **Facts** (`when`): `title`, `cwd`, `cmd`, `domain`, `status`, `exited`, `focused`, `panes`, `tabs`, `zoomed`, `remote`, `local`, `last_exit`, `idle`, `running`
- **Placeholders**: `{pane}`, `{tab}`, `{window}`, `{title}`, `{cwd}`, `{domain}`, `{host}`, `{last_command}`, `{last_output}`, `{exit_code}`
- **Allowed kinds**: `action`, `send`, `spawn`, `ctl`, `submenu`, `separator`, `header`, `include`
- **Shell-registrable**: no

**Built-in items**

- `close`: Close tab, chip of `CloseTab`
- `close_others`: Close other tabs
- `rename`: Rename…
- `color`: Tab Color
